target.text: WHEN THEY WERE ALREADY SO WELL OFF?

target.text: ...WAS THAT HOW I WAS?

target.speaker: character1
target.text: AS LONG AS I HAD POCHITA THAT WAS ENOUGH,

target.speaker: character1
target.text: BUT I STILL DREAMED OF A BETTER LIFE.

target.speaker: character1
target.text: I GET IT. EVERYONE'S GOT THEIR OWN DREAMS.

target.text: THERE'S NOTHIN' WRONG WITH THAT.

target.text: THIS IS THE THIRD CASE THIS YEAR IN OUR JURISDICTION ALONE.

target.speaker: character3
target.text: 'COURSE, THEIR HANDS WERE PRETTY BLOODY TO BEGIN WITH.

target.text: OTHER PEOPLE'S LIVES DIDN'T MEAN A THING TO THEM...

target.text: I THINK CHARLIE HAS THE LIST...

target.speaker: character3
target.text: RIGHT HERE, SIR.

target.text: THE FIRST WAS ON JANUARY THE FIFTH. RICHARD BACH, AGED 45. LIVED ON EAST 152ND.

target.text: SUSPICION OF MOB TIES.

target.text: SHOT HIMSELF IN THE RIGHT TEMPLE WITH A .380 WAD-CUTTER.

target.speaker: character5
target.text: HMM.

target.speaker: character3
target.text: IN THE SECOND CASE, THE IMPORTER -- ALSO UNDER INVESTIGATION FOR SMUGGLING. THIS TIME THERE WERE WITNESSES WHO SAW HIM JUMP OUT HIS APARTMENT WINDOW... RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE OF A FAMILY DINNER.

target.speaker: character2
target.text: AND NOW JERRY WATTS SLITS HIS OWN THROAT WITH A STRAIGHT RAZOR!

target.speaker: character3
target.text: JUMPING OUT A WINDOW... GUNSHOT TO THE HEAD... ORTHODOX SUICIDE.

target.speaker: character3
target.text: WHAT CAN WE REALLY SAY?

target.speaker: character5
target.text: NO, NOT MUCH ROOM FOR SUSPICION.

target.speaker: character5
target.text: NOT UNTIL THIS LAST CASE.

target.speaker: character5
target.text: SAY YOU'RE ACTUALLY HARDCORE ENOUGH TO GO BY CUTTING YOUR OWN THROAT. BUT YOU'VE GOT A BODYGUARD. WELL, SIMPLE WAY WOULD BE IN THE JOHN. WHEN THE KNOCK COMES ON THE DOOR, TEN MINUTES LATER, TUB'S FULL.

target.speaker: character5
target.text: BUT OUR MR. WATTS... FOR SOME REASON, HE LIKED THINGS COMPLICATED. FOR HE FELT THE NEED TO SNEAK UP BEHIND HIS BODYGUARD... AND TAKE THE GOOD TIME AND TROUBLE TO CUT HIS THROAT FIRST.

target.speaker: character3
target.text: YOUR COFFEE, SIR. NO SUGAR.

target.speaker: character5
target.text: HM.

target.speaker: character5
target.text: THANKS, CHARLIE.

target.text: WHAT'S THAT?

target.text: JERRY WATTS'S FILE.

target.speaker: character5
target.text: HMPH.

target.text: READ IT AND YOU'LL FIND IT THAT MUCH HARDER TO BELIEVE HE'D COMMIT SUICIDE.

target.text: BEAT THE RAP ON A FRAUD COUNT THREE TIMES.

target.speaker: character5
target.text: SURVIVOR TYPE, YOU MIGHT SAY.

target.speaker: character1
target.text: EATING BREAD WITH JAM SMOTHERED ALL OVER IT WITH YOU POCHITA, MAKIN' OUT WITH A GIRL, PLAYIN' GAMES TOGETHER IN OUR ROOM... AND FALLIN' ASLEEP IN HER ARMS...

target.speaker: character1
target.text: PRETTY GREAT DREAM, DON'T YOU THINK?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: WOOF

target.speaker: character2
target.text: WOOF

target.speaker: character1
target.text: AT LEAST LET ME DREAM A LITTLE...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: HEY, MURPHY. WHAT'RE YOU GONNA DO WHEN YOU GET BACK HOME?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: HA, HA, HA! WHAT AM I GONNA DO?

target.speaker: character1
target.text: ...GRIFF... IS SOMETHING WRONG, OR...?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: EEEYAAAAAAA

target.speaker: character1
target.text: SHIT! SHIT!

target.speaker: character1
target.text: GRIFF!

target.speaker: character3
target.text: STAY BACK, MAN! HE'S LOST IT!

target.speaker: character3
target.text: DAMNIT!

target.speaker: character1
target.text: ...HNG!

target.speaker: character1
target.text: IS THERE SOME KIND OF PROBLEM WITH THAT? IT'S ONLY FISH. WHY CAN'T YOU JUST TOUCH IT?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: ARE YOU KIDDING ME!?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: IT'S RAW FISH! IT'S ALL SLIMY AND SLIPPERY AND COLD!

target.speaker: character2
target.text: IT FEELS LIKE IT'S ALIVE!!

target.speaker: character2
target.text: I CAN'T... JUST THINKING ABOUT IT IS MAKING ME SICK...

target.speaker: character1
target.text: I'M GONNA BE HONEST, YOU SOUND KIND OF LIKE A LITTLE GIRL RIGHT NOW...

target.speaker: character1
target.text: IT'S NOT LIKE IT'LL ACTUALLY BE LIVE FISH, RIGHT? AND IF YOU DON'T USE IT, IT'LL JUST GET THROWN AWAY!

target.speaker: character1
target.text: THAT WOULD BE RUDE TO THE FISH!

target.speaker: character2
target.text: I DON'T EVEN KNOW HOW TO RESPOND TO THAT...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: WELL, IF IT ISN'T ALIVE, THEN I GUESS I COULD JUST BARELY DO IT...

target.speaker: character3
target.text: SOMEONE TOLD ME

target.speaker: character3
target.text: THAT THEY EVEN GOT A FISH TANK LAST YEAR.

target.speaker: character4
target.text: WOW, THEY'RE REALLY GOING ALL-OUT.

target.speaker: character3
target.text: RIGHT?

target.speaker: character3
target.text: IT'LL BE KIND OF GROSS. THINK YOU'LL BE OKAY?

target.speaker: character4
target.text: I'M A DOCTOR'S SON, REMEMBER? I'LL BE FINE.

target.speaker: character2
target.text: THAT SOUNDS LIKE THEY'RE GOING TO BE ALIVE...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: WE'RE GOING TO BE CUTTING UP LIVE FISH, AREN'T WE?

target.speaker: character1
target.text: W... WELL, YOU DO NEED THAT TO KEEP THEM ALIVE... YEAH.

target.speaker: character2
target.text: I CAN'T EVEN TOUCH DEAD FISH! AND NOW THEY'RE GOING TO BE ALIVE!!?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: YOU HAVE GOT TO BE KIDDING ME!!

target.speaker: character1
target.text: W... WELL, TELLING ME ISN'T GOING TO SOLVE ANYTHING...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: IF WE DO COOKING PRACTICE LIKE THIS...

target.speaker: character1
target.text: IT WILL BE DANGEROUS IF THE NEWCOMERS WERE TO HAVE A STANDOFF WITH THE TARGET GHOUL...

target.speaker: character1
target.text: I MUST GO AHEAD AND STOP THEM EVEN MORE THAN I'D HAVE TO GO FOR A SUBORDINATE...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: WE HAVE OUR OWN WAY OF DOING THINGS, SO PLEASE GIVE UP.

target.speaker: character1
target.text: BUT...!

target.speaker: character2
target.text: ...OR PERHAPS I SHOULD SAY, RANK 1 SASAKI, WAS IT?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: THE SOURCE OF ALL THIS FROM THE START WAS

target.speaker: character2
target.text: THAT YOU COULDN'T CONTROL YOUR SUBORDINATES, WASN'T IT?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: AND WITH THAT REASON DEMANDING "HAND OVER YOUR DATA"...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: IS NOTHING MORE THAN TYRANNY, DON'T YOU THINK?

target.speaker: character3
target.text: SENSEI... LET'S GO ALREADY... WE DON'T HAVE TIME FOR...

target.speaker: character1
target.text: IT'S JUST AS YOU SAID; I MISMANAGED CONTROL...

target.speaker: character1
target.text: I AGREE THAT TELLING YOU TO FREELY SHOW ME YOUR

target.speaker: character1
target.text: PRECIOUS DATA CAN ONLY BE CALLED TYRANNICAL...

target.speaker: character1
target.text: BUT...

target.speaker: character1
target.text: I DO NOT WANT TO EXPOSE MY SUBORDINATES TO DANGER DUE TO MY CARELESSNESS...!

target.speaker: character1
target.text: IF WE MAKE AN ACHIEVEMENT THEN WE WILL HAND THAT OVER TO YOU.

target.speaker: character1
target.text: IF YOU'D JUST GIVE US THE DATA...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: SIGH-

target.speaker: character2
target.text: DID YOU THINK IT'D TURN OUT ALRIGHT IF YOU JUST BOWED YOUR HEAD...?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: HOW TROUBLESOME. DOING THINGS LIKE THIS...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: IS THAT SORT OF THING FITTING FOR A GHOUL INVESTIGATOR?

target.speaker: character2
target.text: LISTEN TO ME. YOU, ALL OF YOU GUYS,

target.speaker: character2
target.text: WELL...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: "YOU" IN PARTICULAR,

target.speaker: character2
target.text: EVEN IF IT WERE A HUMAN THAT'S AN "UPRIGHT INVESTIGATOR" DOING THIS SORT OF THING,

target.speaker: character2
target.text: IT'D BE NO GOOD.

target.speaker: character3
target.text: Talking like that...

target.speaker: character2
target.text: WE HAVE AN INVESTIGATION.

target.speaker: character2
target.text: PLEASE ACCEPT IT.
